citation: Bettahi I, et al. Differences in protein expression, at the basal state and at 2 h of insulin infusion, in muscle biopsies from healthy Arab men with low or high insulin sensitivity. Front Endocrinol 2023;13:1024832.
protocol: Hyperinsulinaemic-euglycaemic clamp: insulin 40 mU/m2/min for 2 h, 20% dextrose adjusted every 5 min to keep blood glucose 90 mg/dl (5 mmol/L); M from last 60 min; muscle biopsies at baseline and 2 h.
population: 16 healthy Arab (Qatar) men chosen from 60 young men: 8 high insulin sensitivity and 8 low, age about 32 y, BMI about 25-26.
note: Extreme-tertile selection, so groups are not representative; M 17 vs 5 mg/kg/min spreads the range. No insulin or FFA values in tables; the main content is proteomics.
